summary: Iteration 14 — Batch B (7 structural items) FULL PASS. Backend 9/9 pytest cases green (login, /auth/me, /accounts/all, /accounts/simplefin/link with scraped demo token → 3 accounts, /payments/products, /payments/checkout coaching + membership both return checkout.stripe.com URLs, /coaching/bookings, /user/membership). Frontend (Playwright mobile 390x844, localhost:3000 after localStorage.clear on every session): (T1 Bottom-nav) [Home, Budget, Transactions, Net Worth, Legacy] exactly — nav-more NOT present. Home top-right profile pill shows 'AW' for Alex Ward; tap → More screen with Coaching / Membership / Settings tiles + working header-back chevron that returns to Home. (T2 Real initials) After Mongo update name='Sarah' → re-login → pill='SA' (single-word first 2 chars); after restore 'Alex Ward' → pill='AW'. (T3 Single source of truth) Fresh state: Home NW=$0, NW hero=$0, Legacy investmentTotal=$0 — identical. After linking demo SimpleFIN (3 accounts, $140,689.98 total): Home NW=$140,690 = NW hero=$140,690 (exact), Cash row source='SimpleFIN · 3 accounts' with value $140,690. (T4 Hypothetical) Card labeled 'Hypothetical Amount' with '+ Add' — sheet 'Add hypothetical amount' opens, enter 50000/Save → card shows '$50,000', 'What we're projecting from' adds champagne-gold '+ Hypothetical amount $50,000' row, Retirement projection jumps from $0 to $633,802. Reopen with 0 → button label reads 'Remove hypothetical' → tap → card back to '+ Add'. (T5 Short-horizon) Pills = exactly [1yr, 2yr, 3yr, 5yr, 10yr, 20yr, Retirement]. On 1yr with hypo=50k / cash=0 / invest=0 / monthlyNet=0: PROJECTED=$50,000, projecting-from card adds 'Current cash (synced) $0' + 'Monthly net (from Budget) $0' rows, Monthly Contribution card HIDDEN. Switching to 10yr: Monthly Contribution reappears, short-horizon rows disappear. Math verified. (T6 Earn) Budget top group 'Earn' with green E badge above 'Plan by Purpose'. Defaults: W-2 Income / Contract Income / Business Income all $0 'tap to set'. Tap W-2 → sheet 'Set expected · W-2 Income' → 5000/Save → row shows '$5,000 expected', Total Income summary 'of $5,000'. '+ Add Earn source' → enter Consulting/1500 → new row 'Consulting $1,500 expected'. Reopen Consulting → red 'Delete this source' → delete → row gone. Reload+login: W-2 still $5,000, Consulting still gone (persisted correctly). (T7 Restricted Cash) Cash Protection strip has 3 cells TOTAL CASH − RESTRICTED = AVAILABLE. RESTRICTED cell $0 'tap to set' champagne-gold. Tap → sheet 'Restricted Cash' → 200/Save → cell shows '$200 tap to edit', AVAILABLE = TOTAL CASH − $200 (verified $140,490 with linked, $0 with none). Post-test cleanup done: linked_accounts + bank_transactions + coaching_bookings + payment_transactions cleared, name reset to 'Alex Ward', password confirmed still 'password123' via login round-trip.

issues: The Home 'RETIREMENT PROJECTION' teaser card computes 33-year compounding on TOTAL NET WORTH ($1,783,393 with $140,690 linked cash), while the Legacy screen Retirement projection uses INVESTMENTS ONLY (shows $0 in same state). Two screens display different retirement numbers based on the same underlying data. Consider aligning the Home teaser to match Legacy's investments-only model, or documenting the intentional difference. index.tsx (HomeScreen legacy teaser vs LegacyScreen). Not a functional break — outside T1-T7 scope.
